race.comment: Wide open. KNIGHTS REIGN (5) could be value. Looked close to a win prior to a last start seventh here. Well weighted with the claim and well drawn. Gets chance to atone. FIERCE 'N FABULOUS (3) was fair fresh at first run for new yard then improved second-up over 1150m to finish third here. Has further upside. Among the winning hopes. NUNKERI (8) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but wound up strongly late when third over 1350m this course and distance last time in the same race as Knight's Reign. Rates highly and can break through. LITTLE EL (4) is a handy type who was an open class winner last campaign but spelled after pulling up sore here last time. Trip suits fresh and has the talented to go close if on song. CITY WOK (1) was a maiden winner here fresh and can only be fitter.
